policy_sources.title: Capstone banking service rules
policy_sources.notes: Requirements selected for transaction accuracy, authorization, outcome clarity, and manager-facing evidence in the capstone evaluator.

policy_sources.title: Observed banking call patterns
policy_sources.reference: ten banking calls in the North American test batch
policy_sources.notes: Used to define supported intents and workflow branches, not to establish external policy requirements.

intents.title: One-time account transfer
intents.description: The customer requests one immediate or scheduled transfer between accounts.
selection_guidance: Select when the requested transfer occurs once.
May be selected together with transfer.recurring when both are requested.

intents.title: Recurring account transfer
intents.description: The customer requests an automatic transfer on a repeating schedule.
selection_guidance: Select when frequency, start date, or automatic recurrence must be configured.
May be selected together with transfer.one_time when both are requested.

intents.title: Open a checking account
intents.description: The customer requests a new checking account, optionally linked to an existing product.
selection_guidance: Select only when account opening is requested during the call.
Do not select merely because a newly opened account is used in another request.

intents.title: Agricultural-equipment loan inquiry
intents.description: The customer asks about financing farm equipment or beginning that application process.
selection_guidance: Distinguish a general product inquiry from an application started during the call.
Do not require account authentication for a general information-only inquiry.

facts.description: The customer asks the agent to perform or schedule a transfer.
The transfer or recurring instruction is completed during the call.
The customer asks the agent to open an account during the call.
The customer requests linkage between the new account and an existing product.
The customer moves from a loan inquiry into an application during the call.

requirements.title: Agent and organization identified
requirements.business_definition: The customer can identify the representative and organization handling the call.
evidence_expectations: Agent states their name and the organization near the beginning of the call.

requirements.title: Customer request confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The agent establishes what the customer wants before taking account or application action.
evidence_expectations: Agent restates or explicitly acknowledges the requested action and important qualifiers.

requirements.title: Outcome and next steps summarized
requirements.business_definition: The customer leaves knowing what occurred and what must happen next.
evidence_expectations: Agent summarizes completed actions or clearly explains pending next steps before closing.

requirements.title: Customer identity verified before transaction access
requirements.business_definition: Account-specific transaction activity follows a clear customer-verification exchange.
evidence_expectations: Agent requests verification information before exposing account details or executing the transaction.
Transcript shows the customer responding to the verification request.

requirements.title: Customer identity verified for account opening
requirements.business_definition: The account-opening process includes a clear identity-verification exchange.
evidence_expectations: Agent requests identity or existing-customer verification before opening the account.

requirements.title: Applicant identity verified when application begins
requirements.business_definition: Identity verification becomes applicable only when the call advances beyond general loan information into an application.
evidence_expectations: Agent performs identity verification before collecting application-specific customer information.

requirements.title: Source and destination accounts confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The transfer direction and both participating accounts are unambiguous.
evidence_expectations: Agent and customer confirm source and destination account types or identifiers.

requirements.title: Transfer amount confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The amount authorized by the customer is explicit before execution or scheduling.
evidence_expectations: Transcript contains an amount and customer confirmation or an equivalent explicit agreement.

requirements.title: Relevant transfer terms explained
requirements.business_definition: The customer receives applicable timing, limit, fee, and modification information without requiring invented terms.
evidence_expectations: Agent explains applicable processing timing, limits, fees, or states that a listed term does not apply.
Recurring transfers include change or cancellation information.

requirements.title: Customer authorizes the transfer
requirements.business_definition: The agent obtains explicit agreement after the material transfer details are established.
evidence_expectations: Customer gives a clear approval after amount, accounts, and timing or frequency are stated.

requirements.title: Transfer completion confirmed
requirements.business_definition: A transfer completed during the call is followed by a recap or confirmation.
evidence_expectations: Agent confirms successful setup or execution and recaps amount, accounts, and timing.
A reference number is useful evidence but is not mandatory when another clear confirmation is present.

requirements.title: Checking-account terms explained
requirements.business_definition: The customer receives the material account features, fees, and usage conditions relevant to the request.
evidence_expectations: Agent discusses applicable fees, account access, and important product conditions.
The evaluator must not require a term that the project profile does not define.

requirements.title: Requested product linkage confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The requested relationship between the new checking account and existing product is understood and confirmed.
evidence_expectations: Agent explains the linkage and confirms the customer's preference.

requirements.title: Customer consents to account opening
requirements.business_definition: The customer explicitly agrees to open the account after relevant terms are discussed.
evidence_expectations: Customer gives clear consent before the account is created.

requirements.title: Account opening confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The customer receives confirmation of the account outcome and access next steps.
evidence_expectations: Agent confirms whether the account was opened and explains access, funding, or remaining setup steps.

requirements.title: Loan purpose and inquiry stage confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The agent establishes the financing purpose and whether the customer wants information or to begin an application.
evidence_expectations: Agent confirms the equipment-financing purpose.
Conversation distinguishes general information from an application.

requirements.title: Loan terms path explained
requirements.business_definition: The customer learns either the applicable high-level terms or how a personalized rate and repayment quote will be obtained.
evidence_expectations: Agent discusses available term categories or explains that rates and repayment depend on application review.
The evaluator must not require an exact rate during a general inquiry.

requirements.title: Loan inquiry next step confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The customer receives a concrete route to continue the loan inquiry or application.
evidence_expectations: Agent provides an application, referral, document request, appointment, or follow-up path.

requirements.title: One-time transfer timing confirmed
requirements.business_definition: The execution date or immediate timing of a one-time transfer is explicit.
evidence_expectations: Agent states the execution timing and the customer accepts it.

requirements.title: Recurring transfer schedule confirmed
requirements.business_definition: Frequency, start timing, and any applicable end condition are explicit.
evidence_expectations: Frequency and start timing are stated and accepted by the customer.

requirements.title: Recurring transfer change path explained
requirements.business_definition: The customer is told how recurring instructions can be changed, paused, or stopped.
evidence_expectations: Agent explains a change, pause, or cancellation path.

requirements.title: Loan eligibility considerations explained
requirements.business_definition: The customer receives a qualified explanation of relevant eligibility factors without a promise of approval.
evidence_expectations: Agent identifies relevant eligibility considerations using qualified language.

requirements.title: Loan document path explained
requirements.business_definition: The customer learns which documents or information are needed to continue.
evidence_expectations: Agent identifies concrete documents or information needed for an application.
